ConfigSource.description: Versioned names make built-in configs reproducible across OCIO upgrades.

oneOf.description: Immutable OCIOZ package, verified before any cache or processor is used.

decontaminate.description: Local foreground/background color reconstruction; 0 preserves RGB, 1 applies fully.

feather.description: Gaussian sigma in original input pixels, applied after refinement/grow.

grow.description: Signed square-kernel dilation/erosion radius in original input pixels.

color.description: Encoded sRGB screen color; must have a dominant color channel.

oneOf.description: Existing ICC / RAW / explicitly declared input colorimetry to working RGB.
Stored rendered RGB values. ICC and transfer decoding are bypassed.
Output only: the pipeline's selected display/view and encoding.
Imported gray/alpha matte. Path is relative to recipe/project directory.
Physical alpha mixtures are linear; normalize HDR magnitude without clipping.
Compatibility with matting workflows operating on encoded sRGB samples.
OCIO owns each Look's process space and context-dependent dependencies.
Native ASC v1.2 SOP/saturation, with an explicit signal encoding.
RGB affine transform; alpha cannot contribute to RGB or be modified.
Native weight-free keying / interactive segmentation / alpha matting.
Native OCIO grade in an explicit process space; requires color_pipeline.
Gains in scene-linear RGB, green normalized by the caller when desired.
Lightroom-style independent tone controls; values in [-1,1].
EV range is relative to linear 18% gray.
Copy source region over target; optional feather blends the boundary.
Two inputs. First is base; second is foreground, mixed using node mix/mask.

Pipeline.description:
An input/display chain around scene-linear grading.
Display outputs are tagged with the corresponding file colorimetry.

context.description: Explicit overrides; absent values use authored defaults, never ambient env.

display_name.description: Custom config display names; encoding remains owned by `display`.

preview_view.description: Required for non-sRGB displays; agent previews remain SDR sRGB.

working_space.description: OCIO color-space name corresponding to the declared linear encoding.

PipelineConfig.description: Legacy string configs remain byte-for-byte compatible in revision hashes.

algorithm_version.description: Version 1 applies sensor normalization and WB before demosaicing.

calibration_illuminant.description: DNG/EXIF illuminant numeric tag, selecting a decoder-supplied camera matrix.

exposure_ev.description: Applied after demosaicing and camera conversion; does not change sensor saturation.

oneOf.description: Use camera metadata; report an explicit D65 fallback when absent.
Camera plane order, normalized to plane 1. Three or four positive gains.
CIE 1931 xy white; computed with the selected D65-adapted camera matrix.

Kang 2002 Planckian-locus fit with signed normal offset in CIE 1960 uv.
Positive Duv describes a greener source white, compensated by camera gains.

output.description: Node ID, or "source" for the unmodified image.

radius.description: Unknown boundary band in refinement-resolution pixels (ignored for explicit trimaps).

oneOf.description: Distance in clamped, encoded sRGB; colors/samples describe the background.

rect.description: [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y], normalized; outside is certain background.

oneOf.description: Grayscale data: <=0.01 background, >=0.99 foreground, otherwise unknown.

repeat.description: [columns, rows], anchored at the uncropped sensor origin.

values.description: Row-major cells with interleaved components per pixel; native sensor units.

radius.description: Radius relative to the shorter image dimension; strokes join consecutive points.

oneOf.description: ST 2084, normalized to 10,000 nits. Linear 1 = 10,000 nits.
Scene-referred HLG OETF only; no display OOTF.
Input and output use the same source encoding; grade owns its process space.
